blocks.prompt: 8. Sum to \(n\) terms the series \(2 + 4x + 6x^{2} + 8x^{3} + \cdots\) where \(x \ne 1\)
blocks.explanation:
An A.G.P. with a letter: A.P. part \(2, 4, 6, 8, \ldots\), G.P. part \(1, x, x^2, \ldots\) (ratio \(x\)).
We divide by \(1 - x\) at the end, which is why \(x \ne 1\) is given.
Plan: \(T_n\), write \(S_n\) and \(xS_n\) shifted, subtract, sum the G.P., divide by \(1 - x\), write as one fraction.
steps:
Given: \(2 + 4x + 6x^2 + \cdots\); A.P. \(a = 2, d = 2\); G.P. \(b = 1, r = x\); \(x \ne 1\)
To find: \(S_n\).
Method: Multiply-by-\(r\)-and-subtract (the method of 6.8.1): write \(S_n\), write \(rS_n\) one place to the right, subtract; the middle becomes a G.P. that we can sum.

The \(n\)th term
\[T_n = 2n\,x^{n-1}\]
Why: A.P. \(n\)th term \(2n\); G.P. \(n\)th term \(x^{n-1}\) (the first term has \(x^0 = 1\)).

Write \(S_n\) and \(xS_n\)
\[S_n = 2 + 4x + 6x^{2} + \cdots + 2n\,x^{n-1}\]
\[xS_n = 2x + 4x^{2} + \cdots\]
\[\quad + 2(n - 1)x^{n-1} + 2n\,x^{n}\]
Why: Multiplying by \(x\) raises each power by one; shift so equal powers line up.

Subtract
\[(1 - x)S_n = 2 + 2x + 2x^{2} + \cdots\]
\[\quad + 2x^{n-1} - 2n\,x^{n}\]
Why: \(S_n - xS_n = (1 - x)S_n\); each pair leaves \(d = 2\) times the power, e.g. \((4 - 2)x = 2x\); the last term \(2nx^n\) is subtracted.

Sum the G.P.
\[2 + 2x + \cdots + 2x^{n-1} = \dfrac{2(1 - x^{n})}{1 - x}\]
\[(1 - x)S_n = \dfrac{2(1 - x^{n})}{1 - x} - 2n\,x^{n}\]
Why: First term 2, ratio \(x\), \(n\) terms (powers 0 to \(n - 1\)).

Divide by \(1 - x\) and combine
\[S_n = \dfrac{2(1 - x^{n})}{(1 - x)^{2}}\]
\[\quad - \dfrac{2n\,x^{n}}{1 - x}\]
\[= \dfrac{2(1 - x^{n}) - 2n\,x^{n}(1 - x)}{(1 - x)^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{2 - 2x^{n} - 2nx^{n} + 2nx^{n+1}}{(1 - x)^{2}}\]
\[= \dfrac{2[1 - (n + 1)x^{n} + n\,x^{n+1}]}{(1 - x)^{2}}\]
Why: Common denominator \((1 - x)^2\); collect the \(x^n\) terms: \(-2x^n - 2nx^n = -2(n + 1)x^n\); take 2 common.

blocks.title: Book correction
blocks.text: The answer key (PDF 305) prints \(S_n = \frac{2 - (n + 1)x^{n} + 2nx^{n+1}}{(1 - x)^{2}}\): the factor 2 is missing on the \((n + 1)x^n\) term. With \(n = 1\), \(x = 2\) it gives 6 instead of the first term 2. Correct: \(S_n = \frac{2[1 - (n + 1)x^{n} + nx^{n+1}]}{(1 - x)^{2}}\).
